apps.name: BYD Sea Lion 06
apps.localizedDescription: Компаньйон для BYD Sea Lion 06: стан авто, клімат, сидіння, камери.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **«Фічі в роботі» dashboard of open OpenSpec changes**, refreshed after every `/developer` ship and daily from `main`
  (`features-dashboard` skill, `scripts/features-dashboard/`).

### Fixed
- **Head-unit Maestro smoke flow** asserts the sidebar instead of «BYD-Telemetry», which the header replaces with the
  profile name; it runs on the `companion_test` emulator in landscape.
- **«Припарковано …» and the parked SOC drain no longer restart from zero** when the app is updated or the keep-alive
  helper is relaunched while the car stands. The helper reads its park record back on start and keeps counting from the
  stored park time and SOC baseline (`openspec/changes/park-counter-resets-while-charging/`).
